info.title: Have I Been Squatted API
info.summary: OpenAPI description for the public v1 API surface represented in this repository.
info.description: This specification documents the HTTP wire format used by the v1 API. Lookup endpoints stream newline-delimited JSON objects. Certificate Transparency and usage endpoints return regular JSON bodies.

tags.name: Lookup
tags.description: Streaming domain lookup and analysis endpoints.

tags.name: Certificate Transparency
tags.description: Search and hydrate certificate transparency records.

tags.name: Usage
tags.description: Usage reporting for the authenticated API key.

get.summary: Look up typosquatted permutations for a domain.
get.description: Streams newline-delimited JSON objects as work completes. Each line is a message with an `op` field and operation-specific `data`.

200.description: NDJSON stream of lookup result messages. The schema and examples describe one line in the stream.

get.summary: Look up unregistered permutations for a domain.
get.description: Streams newline-delimited JSON objects as work completes. Each line is a message with an `op` field and operation-specific `data`.

200.description: NDJSON stream of lookup result messages. The schema and examples describe one line in the stream.

get.summary: Analyze a domain for infrastructure and threat signals.
get.description: Streams newline-delimited JSON objects as work completes. Each line is a message with an `op` field and operation-specific `data`.

200.description: NDJSON stream of analysis messages. The schema and examples describe one line in the stream.

get.summary: Search certificate transparency names by pattern.
get.description: Returns a JSON array of matching names. The response may include the `X-Has-More-Value` header when more matches exist than were returned in the body for the requested limit.

get.summary: Search certificate transparency data for exact FQDNs.
get.description: Repeat the `fqdn` query parameter to request multiple exact names in one call.

200.description: Certificate transparency search results for the requested names.

get.summary: Hydrate certificate transparency occurrences into certificate details.
Retrieve usage totals and hourly breakdown.

200.description: Usage information for the requested window.

bearerAuth.description: Bearer API key created in the Have I Been Squatted application. Keys in current documentation begin with `ak_`.

DomainPath.name: domain
DomainPath.description: Domain name to look up or analyze.

CtPattern.name: pattern
CtPattern.description: Search pattern used by CT search.

CtLimit.name: limit
CtLimit.description: Requested maximum number of search results.

IncludePrecert.name: include_precert
IncludePrecert.description: Compatibility parameter accepted by the API. The current service does not apply it as a server-side filter; inspect each result's `is_precert` value.

CtField.name: field
CtField.description: Low-level indexed-name selector for CT pattern search. `domain_raw` selects the raw name index, while `domain_ngram`/`ngram` select the n-gram path. This is not a certificate-field selector; omit it to let the service choose automatically.

CtFqdnList.name: fqdn
CtFqdnList.description: One or more fully qualified domain names to search exactly.

CtOccurrenceList.name: occ
CtOccurrenceList.description: One or more occurrence IDs in `{log_id}:{index}` format.

XHasMoreValue.description: Present on `/ct/search` responses. `true` means the search found more matching names than were returned in the body for the effective limit.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds until the client should retry after a rate limit response.

XRateLimitLimit.description: Maximum allowed request count for the current rate limit window.

BadRequest.description: The request was invalid for the target endpoint.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, expired, revoked, or otherwise invalid API key.

Forbidden.description: The API key does not have the required scope for this endpoint.

TooManyRequests.description: The API key is rate limited.

StreamMessage.description: One line from a streaming lookup response. The exact shape of `data` depends on `op`.
